prompts.title: Japandi Living Room — Golden Hour Hero
prompts.body: Cinematic interior photograph of a minimalist Japandi living room. Travertine walls, low oak coffee table, linen sofa in oat tone, woven jute rug. Floor-to-ceiling windows pouring golden hour light from camera-left, dust particles softly visible in the light beams. Architectural Digest editorial style, 35mm sensor, shallow depth of field f/2.0, ISO 200, no people. Warm color grade, teal shadows. Ultra-detailed materials.

prompts.title: Master Suite — Twilight Mood
prompts.body: Photorealistic master suite at blue hour. King-size bed with crisp white linen, two bedside Noguchi-style lamps glowing warm 2700K, dark walnut wardrobe wall behind. Floor-to-ceiling windows reveal a São Paulo skyline at twilight with bokeh city lights. Polished concrete floor, soft Persian rug. Camera at chest height, 24mm lens, slight wide-angle. No occupants. Cinematic teal-orange grade, architectural digest tone.

prompts.title: Chef Kitchen — Marble + Brass
prompts.body: Editorial photograph of a chef's kitchen for a R$5M penthouse listing. Calacatta marble island center-frame, brass pendant lights overhead, integrated Sub-Zero fridge, induction cooktop. One window on the right with overcast soft light. Wide-angle 20mm, eye-level. Realistic reflections on marble. Hyper-detailed grain on countertop, water droplets in basin. Architectural digest cover style.

prompts.title: Virtual Staging — Empty to Furnished
prompts.body: Use uploaded reference image of an empty living room. Add furniture preserving exact wall positions, window frames, floor material, ceiling, and all architectural geometry. Insert: a 3-seat oat linen sofa parallel to the windows, a round travertine coffee table, a floor lamp left of sofa, a large neutral wool rug under the seating, and one abstract painting on the back wall. Lighting must match the existing window light direction. Photorealistic, no morphing of walls or floors.

prompts.title: Façade Exterior — Golden Hour Front Elevation
prompts.body: Architectural photograph of a contemporary 3-story luxury house façade in São Paulo. Cor-Ten steel cladding meets travertine base, large pivot front door in walnut. Manicured landscape with three palmeiras imperiais on the right. Camera at street level, slight 3/4 angle showing depth. Golden hour, long warm shadows. Ultra-sharp, 50mm equivalent. No people, no cars in frame. Architectural digest finish.

prompts.title: Penthouse Living — Skyline Reveal
prompts.body: Photorealistic penthouse living area, double-height ceiling, full glass curtain wall revealing Belvedere skyline at blue hour. Sectional charcoal sofa, marble fireplace center-left, vintage Persian carpet. Soft warm interior lighting at 2700K vs cool exterior blue. Camera positioned wide-angle from the back of the room, capturing both interior and view. Architectural digest editorial, hyper-detailed materials.

prompts.title: Walkthrough — Slow Dolly Through Living Room
prompts.body: Slow cinematic dolly-forward shot through a luxury Japandi living room at golden hour. Camera moves at constant 0.5 m/s forward, slight upward arc revealing high ceiling. No people. Soft golden light streams from left windows. Subtle dust particles in beams. Smooth gimbal feel, no motion blur. 8 seconds, 1080p, cinematic teal-orange grade. End frame holds on the window view.

prompts.title: Walkthrough — Reveal Through Doorway
prompts.body: Cinematic shot starting in a hallway looking at a closed double door. Doors slowly open inward to reveal a luxurious master suite at twilight with skyline view behind the bed. Camera glides forward through the doorway at 0.4 m/s. No people. Practical lamps glowing warm, exterior blue hour through floor-to-ceiling windows. 10 seconds, 1080p, anamorphic feel with subtle lens flare on the lamps.

prompts.title: Drone — Exterior Orbit 360
prompts.body: Cinematic aerial drone shot orbiting a 3-story contemporary luxury house in a tropical neighborhood at golden hour. Smooth 90-degree orbit clockwise, drone altitude 25m, camera locked on the house. Reveal pool deck on the back during second half. Lush garden, palmeiras. No people. 12 seconds, 1080p, warm Hollywood grade, slight depth-of-field on background.

prompts.title: Pool Deck — Lifestyle Twilight
prompts.body: Photorealistic infinity pool deck at twilight. Pool water glowing turquoise from underwater lights, deck with two teak sun loungers, low fire-pit center-frame with small flame. Background: lush tropical garden then city skyline bokeh. Camera at deck level, 24mm wide, slight slow-mo wave ripples in pool. No people. Cinematic warm-cool contrast.

behindTheLens.title: Site visit / drone footage capture
behindTheLens.body: iPhone Pro + DJI Mini 4 Pro. Capture 8-12 reference photos covering each room from corner positions + 1 exterior orbit (~3 min footage). Photograph the floorplan if available — even a printed PDF. This is the source of geometric truth that anchors every later prompt.

behindTheLens.title: gpt-image-2 hero stills (3-5x per room)
behindTheLens.body: Feed each reference photo + style-control prompt to gpt-image-2 in image-to-image mode (preserves geometry). Generate 3-5 hero variants per room (golden hour / blue hour / overcast / interior-lit). Pick the best 6 — these are the deliverable stills AND the seeds for video.

behindTheLens.title: seedance-2 walkthroughs (image-to-video)
behindTheLens.body: For each picked hero still: feed it to seedance-2 with a motion prompt ('slow dolly forward, soft golden hour light, 0.5 m/s'). Generate 8s clips at 1080p. 4 walkthroughs total. Re-roll any with morphing artifacts (usually 1 retry suffices).

behindTheLens.title: kling-3 drone orbit + ffmpeg edit
behindTheLens.body: Generate one 12s drone orbit from the exterior hero still on kling-3. Then ffmpeg concat: 6 stills (1s holds with crossfade) + 4 walkthroughs + 1 drone orbit + ambient track. Apply teal-orange LUT. Export 45s reel + standalone stills (PNG 2048px) + 9:16 vertical cut for Instagram.

behindTheLens.title: Deliver + receive feedback
behindTheLens.body: WhatsApp deliverable to construtora + invoice R$8k. Include: 45s 16:9 reel · 45s 9:16 vertical · 6 stills · dossier PDF with property facts overlaid on hero. Offer 1 iteration round bundled (typically used for music change or one room re-staging).

prompts.title: Hook Still — Skincare 9:16 Pattern Interrupt
prompts.body: Vertical 9:16 ad creative for a serum bottle. Macro shot: amber glass dropper bottle suspended mid-air over a marble counter, single drop falling from dropper toward counter, motion blur on drop. Soft beauty light from camera-left, dewy ambient texture in background. Overlay bold text top-third: 'STOP scrolling.' in white sans-serif (Inter Bold). Subtle brand wordmark bottom. High-end editorial cosmetic photography. Ultra-detailed glass refraction.

prompts.title: Product Hero — Smartphone Launch
prompts.body: Ultra-realistic premium smartphone advertisement, hero shot at 3/4 angle on a polished obsidian surface. Single warm rim light from upper-right creating bezel highlight. Screen displaying minimal abstract gradient blue-to-violet. Background gradient fade to black with one bokeh light bottom-left. Overlay caption space top: 'SHOT ON.' Apple-event style. Hyper-detailed materials, no logo placement except a discreet engraving on the side.

prompts.title: UGC Hook — Selfie Mirror Vertical
prompts.body: Vertical 9:16 mirror selfie of a stylish young woman in a softly-lit Brazilian apartment bathroom, casual morning routine vibe, holding a skincare bottle slightly forward toward the mirror, natural smile, no makeup look. Phone visible in her hand. Light from a frosted window left side. iPhone-shot aesthetic, slight phone-grain. Reads as authentic UGC, NOT polished commercial. Overlay text space top-left for hook copy.

prompts.title: Atmospheric Product Ad — Nature Inspired
prompts.body: Nature-inspired atmospheric product advertisement. A premium glass perfume bottle nested among wet moss, ferns, and a small forest creek with shallow water flow. Soft diffused morning light through canopy, dust beams. Macro lens 100mm, shallow DOF on bottle, soft bokeh on greenery. Overall mood: tranquil, organic, premium. Brand-agnostic — leave label area neutral for compositing.

prompts.title: Cosmetic Editorial Ad
prompts.body: Professional advertisement for an indie cosmetics brand. A model's hand holding three lipstick tubes fanned out, hand entering from the right side of frame. Backdrop is a wash of soft pastel coral pink with slight gradient. Top-left area clear for copy overlay. Editorial beauty lighting, soft shadows under lipsticks, slight reflection on tube surfaces. Ultra-clean, modern direct-to-consumer aesthetic.

prompts.title: Surreal Studio Product — Levitation
prompts.body: Surrealist studio product photograph. A premium glass bottle of olive oil levitating diagonally at 30 degrees, frozen mid-spin, a perfect ribbon of golden oil flowing upward defying gravity, suspended olives in geometric pattern around it. Pure white seamless background, sharp soft shadow directly beneath. Studio strobe lighting, ultra-sharp focus across the whole bottle, no motion blur. Pinterest pin energy, commercial high-end.

prompts.title: Hook Video — 3s Product Reveal
prompts.body: Cinematic 6-second vertical 9:16 ad. Frame 1-2s: extreme close-up of a closed cosmetic jar on velvet. Frame 3-4s: an unseen hand opens the jar with a satisfying click, product texture revealed inside. Frame 5-6s: the hand dips finger and pulls back creating a perfect cream peak. Soft warm studio light, sharp close-up macro. No people visible except the hand. Sound-design ready (mic pickup space).

prompts.title: UGC Talking Head — 15s Pitch
prompts.body: Vertical 9:16 video of a young Brazilian woman 25-30 sitting on a casual couch in natural daylight, holding a product, speaking directly to camera with engaged expression, natural hand gestures every few seconds. Phone-shot aesthetic (slight grain, handheld micro-shake). 15 seconds, lip-sync ready for ElevenLabs PT-BR voice over. Background: cozy living room, plants. Authentic UGC vibe, NOT polished commercial.

prompts.title: Cinematic Brand Commercial — Holiday Mood
prompts.body: Cinematic 15-second brand commercial, 16:9, holiday season. Wide shot: snowy small town at dusk, warm window lights, family gathering visible through a bay window. Slow push-in toward the window, then cut to interior close-up of hot drink being poured into a mug branded with [BRAND]. Final beat: family smiles, mug raised. Coca-Cola-2025-holiday-spot quality. Animal characters acceptable to dodge uncanny-valley if needed.

prompts.title: Apple-Event-Style Hero Reveal
prompts.body: Ultra-cinematic 8-second product hero reveal. Frame 1-3s: pitch black, single soft spotlight pulses on. Frame 4-6s: a sleek product slowly rotates into the spotlight from below, refraction caustics dance across surface. Frame 7-8s: settles centered, brand wordmark fades in beneath. 16:9, 4K-grade, deep blacks, cinematic letterbox. No human elements. Designed for projection on big screen.

behindTheLens.title: Steal from winners (Meta Ad Library + TikTok CC)
behindTheLens.body: Before any generation: 30 min in Meta Ad Library + TikTok Creative Center for the brand's category. Screenshot top 10 winners. Identify hook patterns (3s opening · pattern interrupt · UGC vs polished). This is the prompt-seed.

behindTheLens.title: gpt-image-2 hook stills batch (10x)
behindTheLens.body: Generate 10 hook still variants from the winning patterns. Different angles, lighting, copy positions. These are the A/B test universe — pick the 3 strongest by gut + send to client for vote.

behindTheLens.title: seedance-2 + Higgsfield Marketing Studio (6-9s each)
behindTheLens.body: Turn 3 picked stills into 6-9s vertical videos via seedance-2 (image-to-video). Parallel: run Higgsfield Marketing Studio with product URL → UGC avatar variant. End with 5-8 video assets ready for ffmpeg.

behindTheLens.title: ffmpeg variant explosion (20+ assets)
behindTheLens.body: Single source 6s video × 5 caption overlays × 4 CTA endings = 100 variants in 2 hours. Use ffmpeg scriptable batch: caption SRT + watermark + 9:16 crop. Export all as .mp4 H.264 8Mbps · Meta-friendly.

behindTheLens.title: Ship + measure + scale winners with humans
behindTheLens.body: Upload 20 variants to Meta/TikTok in 1 ad set. After 72h, identify CPM/CTR winners (typically 2-3 out of 20). Brief a HUMAN UGC creator to remake the winner concept at scale (Arcads/Creatify/real creator) — AI did the testing-phase work, humans scale the gold.

Vertical 9:16 for Instagram / TikTok feed promo.

prompts.title: Cafe Interior — Lifestyle Brunch Mood
prompts.body: Cinematic photograph of a Brazilian specialty cafe interior, mid-morning. Marble counter front-left with brass espresso machine, hanging Edison bulbs warm 2700K, exposed brick wall behind, two customer silhouettes blurred at a window table catching warm São Paulo light. Wood floor. Camera 35mm slight wide. Editorial brunch-magazine feel. Café-as-place vibe — for Google Business / Instagram bio header.

prompts.title: Pasta Sizzle Reel — 8s Close-up
prompts.body: Cinematic 8-second 9:16 vertical video. Frame 1-3s: extreme close-up of fresh pasta in a steaming bowl, steam rising in soft wisps. Frame 4-6s: a fork twirls strands with slow practiced motion, sauce coats glistening. Frame 7-8s: fork lifts upward out of frame, single strand of cheese stretches. Warm restaurant lighting, shallow DOF, no human face visible. Sound-design ready (sizzle + fork ASMR).

prompts.title: Cocktail Pour — Slow-Mo Hero
prompts.body: Cinematic 6-second 9:16 vertical video of a craft cocktail being poured. Frame 1-2s: dark cinematic background, single coupe glass center. Frame 3-4s: amber cocktail pours from above in slow motion, perfect ribbon, ice cubes already in glass. Frame 5-6s: pour stops, small splash, garnish (orange peel) dropped in from above. Moody bar lighting, single warm rim light. No people. Audio cue: pour + ice clink.

prompts.title: Chef POV — Plating Sequence
prompts.body: 9:16 vertical video, 10 seconds, chef's POV (first-person, hands visible from below frame). Sequence: chef's hands enter frame with tweezers, place 3 microgreens precisely on a plated dish. Then a hand drizzles olive oil from a small cruet. Plate centered on white marble counter. Soft overhead kitchen lighting, slightly warm. Authentic restaurant-kitchen feel, not staged. TikTok plating-video aesthetic.

prompts.title: Burger Hero — Drip + Steam
prompts.body: Cinematic 6-second 16:9 video. Frame 1-2s: a perfect cheeseburger on a wooden board, center. Frame 3-4s: slow zoom in, cheese starts melting visibly, single drop of sauce begins to fall from edge. Frame 5-6s: drop hits the board with subtle splash, steam wisp rises behind. behindTheLens.title: Phone photos + menu CSV from chef
behindTheLens.body: Restaurant sends 8-15 phone photos of their actual signature dishes + plain-text menu (or PDF). No reshoot. The phone photos are the geometric truth — Murilo doesn't fabricate dishes, only enhances real ones (anti-Ethos-ATX rule).

behindTheLens.title: nano-banana-pro enhance batch (10-15 dishes)
behindTheLens.body: Feed each phone photo + 'enhance lighting, neutralize background, preserve dish geometry' prompt. Batch via fal.ai (parallel runs). Output: each dish in 5:4 (Uber Eats catalog) + 16:9 (DoorDash header) + 4:5 (Instagram).

behindTheLens.title: gpt-image-2 hero shots for 3 signature dishes
behindTheLens.body: For the 3 most-ordered items, generate ground-up hero shots in gpt-image-2 with full editorial prompt (steam, drip, golden hour, props). These are the Instagram-feed + menu-cover stars.

behindTheLens.title: seedance-2 sizzle reels (3 × 6-8s) + kling-3 chef-POV
behindTheLens.body: From the 3 hero stills, generate 3 sizzle reels (steam rise, sauce drip, fork twirl) via seedance-2. Plus 1 chef-POV plating sequence via kling-3 for TikTok. ffmpeg crops to 9:16 + 1:1.

behindTheLens.title: Deliver bundle + upload assistance
behindTheLens.body: WhatsApp: ZIP with all formats (5:4 / 16:9 / 4:5 / 9:16 / 1:1) + 4 video reels + 1 PDF mapping each asset to its target platform. Invoice R$2.2k. Optional add-on: upload to Uber Eats/iFood/Rappi for the restaurant (+R$400).
